title: Skip placement order — Skip BEFORE conditions
description: Trigger shape for B1: paginated cursor (start) on a parent table whose where clause includes an EXISTS-correlated subquery. Per TS builder.ts:302-345 the pipeline should be Source → Skip → CSQ-Exists → Filter → ... — Skip lands BEFORE conditions. Current Rust does Source → Filter+Exists → Skip, which diverges architecturally even when both produce the same payload for this exact AST. Wave 1 fix realigns the order; this stub becomes the regression test that proves the new ordering still works.
wave1_action: Re-run differential sweep against this AST after B1 fix lands; assert TS and RS payloads byte-equal.
